description: List what the NutsGrowth directory files as a replacement for a named product, e.g. "Notion" or "Google Drive", with the same filters as search_tools. Matching is on the product's name as the directory writes it; when nothing matches, the answer suggests names it does file alternatives for. Returns at most 10 listings and the total, in alphabetical order.

category.description: A category slug from list_filters. Includes its sub-categories.

country.description: Where the company is based: an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code such as "DE", or the name list_filters gives.

free_plan.description: Only listings that have (true) or do not have (false) a free plan or free tier, by a price a person checked.

limit.description: How many to return. At most 10, which is also the default.

open_source.description: Only listings that are (true) or are not (false) open source.

price_checked.description: Only listings whose price a person has (true) or has not (false) checked.

product.description: The product to replace, by name.

self_hostable.description: Only listings that can (true) or cannot (false) be run on your own servers.

tags.description: Up to 5 tag slugs from list_filters. A listing must carry all of them.

name: find_alternatives
title: Find alternatives to a product
